name: Government organization classification
description: What kind of body this is. Aligned with Popolo Organization.classification and the W3C Organization Ontology.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Legislature
hasDefinedTerm.description: An elected deliberative body: council, assembly, parliament, board of supervisors.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Executive
hasDefinedTerm.description: The head of government's office: mayoralty, cabinet, city manager's office.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Department
hasDefinedTerm.description: An operating unit delivering services under the executive.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Agency
hasDefinedTerm.description: A body with delegated authority, often at arm's length from the executive.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Committee
hasDefinedTerm.description: A subset of a legislature or board, usually with a standing subject remit.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Commission
hasDefinedTerm.description: An appointed body with review, advisory, or quasi-judicial authority.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Office
hasDefinedTerm.description: A named office held by one person, e.g. an auditor or ombudsman.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Public enterprise
hasDefinedTerm.description: A government-owned commercial entity: utility, transit operator, port authority.
